The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] established a small '''outpost''' on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The outpost consisted of two watchtowers and fortified walls that protected two small dome-shaped buildings. It was established in the jungles near a river. Imperial [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] and two [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|AT-STs]] guarded the outpost.<ref name="SWG:CoA" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Maximilian Veers/Legends|Veers]] stayed at this outpost for a short time during the [[Project Dead Eye]] incident.<ref name="SWG:CoA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial outpost was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:CoA" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

The building was one of the five small Imperial outposts — along with the [[Imperial outpost (Dantooine)|Dantooine]], [[Imperial outpost (Dathomir)|Dathomir]], [[Imperial outpost (Endor)/Legends|Endor]] and [[Imperial outpost (Lok)|Lok outposts]] — added to the game for the second act of the "[[:w:c:swg:Cries of Alderaan|Cries of Alderaan]]" story arc,<ref name="SWG:CoA" /> released with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 3 Notes: 8 October 03|Publish 3]]" on [[October 8]], 2003.<ref name="SonyCite-Publish 3: The Warren">{{SonyCite|url=recent_updates.jsp?o=60890|text=Publish 3: The Warren}}</ref> Imperial players were randomly sent to one of the five outposts during the second act to meet with an Imperial [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] who sent the player to a communications outpost to relay a message to [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Vacca]].<ref name="SWG:CoA" /> During the third act of the story arc, introduced with an [[W:c:swg:Update Notes: 22 January 04|update]] published on [[January 22]], [[2004]],<ref name="SonyCite-Publish 5: Vehicles">{{SonyCite|url=recent_updates.jsp?o=60892|text=Publish 5: Vehicles}}</ref> the players were once again sent to one of these outposts to meet with Colonel Veers, who asked the player to attack a Rebel research facility.<ref name="SWG:CoA" />
